project_info.color_palette: Shopee red, orange gradient, black, white, electric blue

main_subject.detail: A simple schedule poster with three creator portrait cards on an orange-red stage background. The cards read '10.7 | 10H GIANH LAM', '15.7 | 10H NGHI GIAO', and '15.7 | 12H NGOC TAM'. A blue footer strip reads 'TU NGAY 10.7 - 15.7' and 'DON XEM TAI Shopee LIVE'.
main_subject.style: Clean livestream lineup board with high-contrast portrait cards and simple program-grid logic

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Shopee Live creator schedule. Centerpiece is a triangular arrangement of three creator portrait cards over a red vertical-texture stage background. Background is a bright Shopee-red field with subtle connector lines. Surrounding elements: white Shopee logo at top left, portrait cards labeled '10.7 | 10H GIANH LAM', '15.7 | 10H NGHI GIAO', and '15.7 | 12H NGOC TAM', plus a blue footer reading 'TU NGAY 10.7 - 15.7' and 'DON XEM TAI Shopee LIVE'. Technical style: program schedule poster with photo cutouts and simple vector framing, flat promotional stage lighting, crisp cutout edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
